intro: Round 2 of the consistency pass: every picture that changed between main and the Round 2 branch, old on the left, new on the right. Made by node tools/picture-diff-page.js --git origin/main HEAD docs/handoff/consistency/round2-compare.html "Round 2 — before and after" --notes docs/handoff/consistency/round2-compare-notes.json

sections.title: Part 12 — sheets and dialogs (Stage 43, P1–P6)
sections.line: Every pop-up has one look: centred on the iPad, from the bottom on the phone, one ✕ of at least 44px top right; the edit, activity and training forms keep their right-side panel on the iPad; yes/no dialogs keep only Cancel; money pop-ups keep their area colours (P1–P4). The handle bar shows only on phone sheets and the ✕ stays in view while a tall sheet scrolls (P5, P6, built in Stage 63).

sections.title: Stage 62 — parent kit, Monthly on a phone
sections.line: The parent pages (Monthly, Copy a week, Access, Profiles, Preferences, School calendar) use the kit buttons and cards; Monthly on a phone has 7 equal columns that shrink, and Sunday's right edge stays on screen at 360px.

sections.title: Stage 63 — kit buttons, nav colour, teal step, Not now
sections.line: The other files' old buttons are kit buttons; the current nav tab takes the planner's picked colour; the meeting's current step is teal (yellow is only the main action); "Not now" on the Record and request sheets is a kit secondary button.

sections.title: Fix — sheet ✕ at the top right (P4/P6)
sections.line: ✕ fixed to the top right of every sheet (P4/P6): the sheet box no longer scrolls, its content scrolls inside it, and the ✕ stays in the top-right corner on short, tall, docked and phone sheets, covering no button.

sections.title: Part 13 — clean-up and guards (Stage 45)
sections.line: The old buttons are gone: the 32 pictures below are the three form sheets' picks, now kit chips, and the Week's + buttons, now kit icon buttons. The red OK is kept only for what cannot be undone — 8 red, 4 normal, 2 red only when blocks are lost. Copy a day says "N blocks will be replaced" (not "planned": the count includes ticked blocks), which differs from P9's example.
items: Red: Reset week — "Reset all chore data (and pocket money) for week of <Mon date>?" (Reset)
Red: Start a day over — "Start <day> over? This takes off: … There is no undo." (Start over)
Red: Remove a goal — "Remove this goal?" (Remove)
Red: take an activity off the list — "Take "<activity>" off the list? It is on N days from today onward — those will be removed." (Take it off)
Red: Reset a routine — "Reset this routine to the built-in default? Your edits will be lost." (Reset)
Red: Delete a routine — "Delete this routine?" (Delete)
Red: replace from a backup — "This replaces the N weeks on this device with the M in the backup. It can't be undone." (Replace everything)
Red: Copy a week over planned blocks — "Replace N blocks already planned in <week>? … Nothing in <week> is touched." (Replace them)
Normal: Box it anyway — ""<item>" looks like <rule> — the rulebook says that's never boxed. … Box it anyway?"
Normal: an exercise off the list — "Take this exercise off the girls' list?" (Take it off)
Normal: a child-added activity off the list — "Take this activity the child added off the list?" (Take it off)
Normal: Retire a chore — "Retire "<chore>"? Past weeks keep every grade it already earned." (Retire)
Red only when blocks are lost: a repeat cut short — "Run this repeat until <day>? … N planned blocks will be removed. Days already ticked or confirmed are kept either way." (Update it)
Red only when blocks are lost: Copy a day — "Copy <day>'s plan? … N blocks will be replaced: …" (Copy it)

sections.title: Stage 64 — read-only Sunday-start line on the backup screen (P10)
sections.line: The parent backup screen has one new line under "On this device now": Sunday-start money rule: none saved — or "saved, from <date>" when this iPad's rulebook holds a Sunday-start rule, or "withdrawn, ignored" for the old shipped pair. It only reads; nothing is saved. The 4 backup pictures below are that line.

sections.title: Test note — emoji not hidden (deviation)
sections.line: Colour emoji are not hidden in the picture test: hiding them moved the text after each emoji. The retry loop stays (a differing picture is shot again up to 2 times), and a planted check proves a real change still fails through it: a 1px red outline on the confirm dialog's Cancel button must still differ after both re-shots, inside the button's box.
